overviewHtml:
Teams that want a quick, lightweight alert on problems, deployments or workflow results often have no simple way to reach a phone.

What you get

  • One HTTP request task that posts a message to an ntfy.sh topic
  • Push notifications in the ntfy app or web client for everyone subscribed
  • A task you can copy into your own workflows
  • Support for self-hosted ntfy servers
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace SaaS with Workflows
  • ntfy.sh (or your self-hosted ntfy server) in the allowed outbound connections
  • The ntfy app, subscribed to your topic
setupHtml:
1. Download ntfy-push-notification.workflow-template.yaml and upload it in Workflows.
  2. Replace YourTopicHere in the URL with your topic name.
  3. Choose Run. The message arrives on every subscribed device.
getStartedHtml:
You need Dynatrace Workflows and the ntfy app subscribed to a topic.

  1. Upload the workflow template in Workflows
  2. Replace the placeholder with your topic name
  3. Run it and check your device
